### Entry or document
Name and URL, or the repository file:

### What you observed
What appears wrong, when you checked it, and the public evidence supporting a correction:

### Suggested correction (optional)
A better canonical URL or original wording, if known. A 403, login requirement, or timeout
alone does not establish that a resource is dead.

### Affiliation and assistance
Disclose any connection to the resource and material AI assistance, if applicable.
Do not include credentials, private research, personal records, or restricted data.
Original text offered for inclusion follows LICENSING.md (CC BY 4.0 content; MIT code).
